question.worked_solution:
First, notice that the numbers $1$ and $1000$ are both perfect cubes.

So, to determine the value of $\sqrt[3]{-\frac{1}{1,000}},$ we express $-\frac{1}{1,000}$ as a perfect cube:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{-\frac{1}{1,000}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{(-1)^{3}}{{10}^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{(-1)\cdot (-1)\cdot (-1)}{10\cdot 10\cdot 10}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{(-\frac{1}{10})\cdot (-\frac{1}{10})\cdot (-\frac{1}{10})} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(-\frac{1}{10})}^{3}} & = \\ -\frac{1}{10} & \end{aligned}
$$
